name: Window Through Time
source:
You play as Ember (name can be changed and choose your own pronouns) who has been speaking to their favorite author using a magical device called a Tempus Window. The Tempus Window allows the user to see their current location at a different time up to 100 years in the past. Today will be your last conversation, how will it end?

[From [url=https://eerie-mori.itch.io/window-through-time]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演艾姆伯（可自定义姓名与人称代词），借助一件名为“时之窗”的魔法器物与自己最喜爱的作家隔空交谈。“时之窗”能让使用者窥见自身所处地点在过去最多100年间的不同时空景象。今天将是你们最后一次交谈——这段对话会迎来怎样的结局？

[摘自[url=https://eerie-mori.itch.io/window-through-time]itch.io[/url]]
